description: MIZAN datasheet schema for datasets used in UAE government AI deployments. Extended from Gebru et al. 2021 (Datasheets for Datasets, Communications of the ACM, Vol. 64, No. 12, pp. 86-92) with UAE AI Governance Framework alignment fields, UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) compliance fields, Arabic language fields, and government data classification fields.

base_references.citation: Gebru, T., Morgenstern, J., Vecchione, B., Vaughan, J. W., Wallach, H., Daume III, H., and Crawford, K. (2021). Datasheets for Datasets. Communications of the ACM, Vol. 64, No. 12, pp. 86-92. https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3458723

uae_extensions_rationale: Gebru et al. 2021 provides the canonical framework for dataset transparency but predates UAE PDPL implementation and does not address Arabic-language data quality or UAE government data classification requirements. Extensions cover: (1) PDPL lawful basis and consent for data collection; (2) sensitive data categories under PDPL Article 3; (3) cross-border data transfer position; (4) Arabic language and dialect quality fields, which are essential for evaluating Arabic-language model training and evaluation sets; (5) government data classification and clearance fields required for datasets sourced from or describing government operations.

motivation.description: Purpose and origin of the dataset. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 1.

purpose_en.description: For what purpose was the dataset created? In English.

purpose_ar.description: Purpose in Arabic. RASHID review required.

created_by.description: Who created the dataset (individual, team, or organisation)?

funded_by.description: Who funded the creation of the dataset?

contact.description: Contact point for questions about the dataset.

composition.description: What the dataset is and what it contains. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 2.

instance_types_en.description: What do the instances in the dataset represent (text, images, structured records, conversation transcripts, etc.)? In English.

instance_count.description: Total number of instances in the dataset.

languages.description: Languages present in the dataset, using ISO 639-1 codes (e.g. ar, en).

contains_personal_data.description: Does the dataset contain personal data as defined under UAE PDPL?

contains_sensitive_data.description: Does the dataset contain sensitive personal data as defined under PDPL Article 3?

known_errors_en.description: Any known errors, sources of noise, or redundancies in the dataset. State none if not applicable.

confidentiality_restrictions.description: Any confidentiality or access restrictions applying to the dataset.

represents_population.description: What population or phenomenon does the dataset represent? Does it represent the UAE population it will be used to serve? Note any representativeness gaps.

collection_process.description: How the data was collected. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 3.

collection_mechanism_en.description: How was the data collected? Describe the mechanism and any tools or infrastructure used.

collection_timeframe.description: Over what timeframe was the data collected?

data_subjects_notified.description: Were individuals whose data is included notified of the collection? Required disclosure under PDPL.

consent_obtained.description: Was consent obtained from individuals whose personal data is included? Note: consent may not be the applicable lawful basis; see lawful_basis field.

third_party_data_included.description: Does the dataset include data from third parties? If true, describe the source and any licence or agreement governing its use.

preprocessing_cleaning_labelling.description: Pre-processing applied to the data. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 4.

preprocessing_applied.description: Was any pre-processing, cleaning, or labelling applied to the raw data?

preprocessing_description_en.description: Description of pre-processing steps applied. In English.

raw_data_retained.description: Is the raw (pre-processed) data also available?

labelling_mechanism.description: If the dataset includes labels, describe who created them and by what process.

uses.description: Intended and prohibited uses. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 5.

intended_uses_en.description: Tasks the dataset has been used for or is intended to be used for.

uses_to_avoid_en.description: Uses for which the dataset should not be used, including out-of-distribution deployment and uses that would violate UAE law or the PDPL.

distribution.description: How the dataset is distributed. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 6.

distribution_channel.description: How is the dataset distributed (internal only, licensed access, public repository, etc.)?

licence.description: Licence governing use and redistribution of the dataset.

ip_restrictions.description: Any intellectual property restrictions applicable to the dataset content.

maintenance.description: Ongoing stewardship of the dataset. Adapted from Gebru et al. 2021 Section 7.

maintained_by.description: Who is responsible for maintaining the dataset?

update_policy.description: Will the dataset be updated? If so, how and on what schedule?

retention_period.description: How long will the dataset be retained? For datasets containing personal data, this must be consistent with the PDPL retention limitation principle.

deletion_procedure.description: Procedure for deleting personal data on expiry of the retention period or on receipt of an erasure request under PDPL Article 12-17.

pdpl_fields.description: UAE-EXTENSION. Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) compliance disclosures for the dataset. All fields apply where personal data is present.

lawful_basis_for_collection.description: Lawful basis under PDPL Article 4 for collecting the personal data in this dataset. Must be one of: consent; contractual necessity; data subject made information public; protection of data subject interests; legal claim or judicial procedure; medical or public health purposes; archival, scientific, historical, or statistical purposes; public interest necessity; legal obligation compliance.

sensitive_data_categories.description: Sensitive personal data categories present under PDPL Article 3. Include all that apply: race or ethnicity; political views; philosophical views; religious beliefs; criminal record; biometric data; health data; sexual status.

consent_mechanism_description.description: Description of how consent was obtained. Under PDPL Article 6, consent must be clear, simple, unambiguous, and accessible with easy withdrawal procedures.

data_minimisation_applied.description: Whether data minimisation was applied in collection and retention, consistent with the UAE AI Ethics Guide Privacy principle.

cross_border_transfer.description: Whether the dataset has been or may be transferred to processors outside the UAE.

cross_border_transfer_basis.description: Basis and safeguards for cross-border transfer. Specify destination country, whether adequate protection exists, and the transfer mechanism. See SOVEREIGN-TODO G-003 regarding the specific PDPL article number.

data_residency.description: Country or region where the dataset is stored and processed.

dpia_conducted.description: Whether a Data Protection Impact Assessment was conducted under PDPL Article 21.

data_protection_officer_contact.description: Contact for the Data Protection Officer where applicable under PDPL Article 10.

arabic_language_fields.description: UAE-EXTENSION. Arabic language quality and coverage disclosure. Required for any dataset used to train or evaluate a model intended for UAE government Arabic-language deployment.

arabic_content_included.description: Whether the dataset includes Arabic-language content.

arabic_dialect_distribution.description: Approximate distribution of Arabic content across dialect and register categories. Percentages must sum to 100. Gulf Arabic representation is particularly important for UAE government deployments.

arabic_quality_verified.description: Whether Arabic content quality has been verified by a native Arabic-speaking reviewer.

arabic_quality_verification_method.description: Description of the Arabic quality verification method and who conducted it.

rtl_formatting_validated.description: Whether right-to-left formatting and bidirectional text handling have been validated in the dataset.

known_arabic_quality_issues.description: Known quality issues in the Arabic content, including any translation artefacts, dialect misclassifications, or coverage gaps.

government_data_fields.description: UAE-EXTENSION. Government data classification and clearance fields. Required for datasets sourced from or describing UAE government operations, services, or citizens.

government_entity_sources.description: List of UAE government entities from which data in this dataset was sourced, if any. State none if not applicable.

classification_level.description: Classification level of the dataset contents. One of: public; internal; confidential; secret. Must align with the UAE Government Information Security Regulation classification scheme.

regulatory_clearance_obtained.description: Whether regulatory clearance from the relevant UAE government authority has been obtained for the collection and use of this dataset.

clearance_authority.description: The UAE government authority that granted clearance and the reference number of the clearance.

national_ai_strategy_alignment.description: If applicable, describe how this dataset supports the objectives of the UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031, particularly Arabic AI development.
